description: Price an email verification waterfall: the list run through verifiers in sequence with unknowns passed down the chain, every order compared, cheapest cost per usable email first. Uses typical figures for three verifiers unless you pass your own prices and resolve rates (POST JSON for verifiers).

verifiers.description: Optional: up to 5 verifiers with pricePer1k (USD), resolvePct (share given a definite answer) and validOfResolvedPct (share of those that are valid).
